ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of cell structure. In the middle of the image there is a relatively large circular structure, like a cell nucleus; at the central position inside this circular structure, there is a smaller, denser yellow/orange small body. Reasoning: The question asks what the central part in the image is. According to knowledge of biological cell structure, the smaller and dense central structure located inside the cell nucleus is called the nucleolus. Therefore the central part is the nucleolus.
